Frost SpacePassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the beginning of the enemy's turn, there is a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Frost Spell] on the enemy for 3 turns. Besides, there is a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Frost Spell] on the enemy for 3 turns for every 1 layer of [Bleed] inflicted. The chances of inflicting [Frost Spell] are not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES. [Frost Spell]: Each layer increases [Bleed] DMG taken by 2% when decreasing Freeze Effect RES by 1.5%.
